_comment: One published jar per group, built from the group's first version (the lead) and declaring the group's
Minecraft versions. A version may only join a group if (1) its own build compiles to classes byte-identical
to the lead's (verifyGroupClasses) and (2) the in-game tests pass on it (runClientGameTest).
Every member compiles at the lead's Java level so the comparison is exact. Never list an untested version.
